Look out for the giant boss!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 22 ([[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} {{QuoteBox|Get ready for a GIANT boss!|Beginning of Wave 22 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Amalgamation''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared in [[Polluted Wasteland]], replacing the [[Giant Boss]]. While replacing the [[Giant Boss]] whenever it was meant to spawn in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode in [[Polluted Wasteland]], the '''Amalgamation''' was much faster than the [[Giant Boss]] while also having 3,000 more health. In addition, the '''Amalgamation''' had a constant health regeneration ability, which made it hard to kill without teamwork. The '''Amalgamation''' used to spawn from the [[Mystery Boss]] upon its death in [[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode only. ==Appearance== The '''Amalgamation's''' appearance was similar to the second version of the [[Tank]] (with even more likeness to the removed [[Tank 2]]). It had regular arms and red skin. Its torso was slightly bloated and tumors could be seen on its left arm and back. The '''Amalgamation''' had black pants with bones sticking out of its arms. It also had a happy drooling face with red glowing eyes. It had the same walking animation as the [[Wasted Boss]]. The '''Amalgamation''' emitted healing particles every time it healed. ==Strategy== *The '''Amalgamation''' is extremely dangerous when it first debuts. Major preparations must be made multiple waves before it spawns. *High DPS towers are required to take the '''Amalgamation''' down. The [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] help massively. **Placement is key; if given any breathing room, the '''Amalgamation''' will heal up all the damage it has taken. Ensure your towers cover as much path as possible. ***The [[Ranger]] with its long range can be good for this. The [[DJ Booth]] also boosts range. **The [[Swarmer]]'s ''Beehive Grenade'', when stacked, can take the '''Amalgamation''' out. **The [[Farm]] should be used to get these towers. *The [[Military Base]] can be surprisingly good at dealing with the '''Amalgamation'''. The [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] and [[Railgun Tank]] do massive collision damage, and with enough of them the '''Amalgamation''' can be defeated with relative ease. **This requires multiple players to commit to using the [[Military Base]]. *Slowing towers can be beneficial considering the '''Amalgamation's''' fast speed. *Later on in the game, '''Amalgamations''' may still pose a threat, especially when spawned in excess from [[Mystery Boss]]es and boosted by [[Circuit (Hardcore)|Circuit]]s. **By this point, many high DPS towers, inclusive of [[Accelerator]]s and [[Ranger]]s, should have been placed down. There should also be chaining of the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability, and the [[DJ Booth]] boosting every single tower. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:ZombieDeath.ogg]] | Death sound |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} Cb1220d53048e4045717a767e76235da.jpg|The '''Amalgamation''' on the game thumbnail. }} ==Trivia== *The [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] improperly calls this enemy a [[Giant Boss]]. **This is because the [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]]'s dialogue for [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode was not changed in [[Polluted Wasteland]]. ==Update History== *'''29 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.10|Release v1.10.0]] **'''Amalgamation '''added. *'''29 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.10|Release v1.10.0a]] **''Regeneration'' ability changed from regenerating 10% of its current health every second to 5% of its current health every second. *'''1 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.10|Release v1.10.0b]] **''Regeneration'' ability changed, from regenerating 5% of its current health every second to 3% of its max health every second. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Amalgamation''' removed. {{FallenNuclear|[[Fallen]]|Wave 20|Amalgamation|Wave 22|[[Shadow Boss]]|Wave 24}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Polluted Wasteland]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:Amalgamation}}
